name: Screen Vision
description: Look at what is currently on the user screen and answer a question about it. Use this whenever they refer to something visible - "what does this error say", "what am I looking at", "read this for me", "is this right" - rather than asking them to type it out. Captures the whole desktop at the moment you call it.
